label: Anime Cast Life Orchestra
intent: Turn the 225 FLUX anime cast portraits into living animation-adjacent keyframes by preserving identity first, then adding gesture, environment, and cinematic motion.

selection.notes: Use --limit 30 for a fast scout, omit it for all 225 source images.

passes.label: Identity Breath
passes.prompt: Preserve the exact character identity from the source portrait: {persona}. Make it feel alive with a subtle {beat}, tiny expression shift, natural eye focus, soft secondary motion in hair and clothing, cinematic hybrid anime still, clean face structure, no new headwear, no animal features, no extra limbs.

passes.label: Gesture Keyframe
passes.prompt: Use the previous image as the identity anchor. Same character: {persona}. Turn the portrait into a mid-action animation keyframe: {beat}, shoulders and hands implying motion, stronger silhouette, hand-painted motion accents, readable body language, polished 3D form with 2D paint, no animal features, no duplicate face.

passes.label: World Insert
passes.prompt: Keep the same character identity and gesture, but place them into a living cinematic environment: {world}. Add depth layers, practical lights, foreground occlusion, atmospheric particles, moving reflections, scene continuity, high-end animated series frame, no text, no split screen.

passes.label: Alive Poster
passes.prompt: Transform the living scene into a final hero key visual while preserving the core character: {persona}. Dynamic composition, cinematic lens compression, expressive eye line, strong rim light, environmental motion trails, vivid but controlled palette, production-quality anime film still, no logo, no lettering, no animal features.
